description_en: Lists the custom domain names for a private gateway
description_zh: 查询私有网关自定义域名列表
kebab_example: aliyun eas list-gateway-domains --cluster-id cn-shanghai --gateway-id gw-1uhcqmsc7x22000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListGatewayDomains

parameters.help_en: The region where the private gateway is located
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the private gateway. To get this ID, see the GatewayId field in the response from the ListGateway (https://apiworkbench.aliyun-inc.com/document/eas/2021-07-01/ListGateway?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.765e281fL2IcjJ\&ampEnv=online) API operation
parameters.help_zh: 私有网关ID。如何获取私有网关ID，请参见接口ListGateway (https://apiworkbench.aliyun-inc.com/document/eas/2021-07-01/ListGateway?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.765e281fL2IcjJ&ampEnv=online)返回结果中的GatewayId字段
parameters.name: gateway_id

CustomDomains.description_en: The list of custom domain names

items.description_en: The details of the custom domain name

CertificateEndDate.description_en: The expiration date of the certificate

CertificateId.description_en: The ID of the SSL certificate attached to the domain name. To obtain the certificate ID, upload or purchase a certificate in the Digital Certificate Management Service (https://yundunnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.2020520163.console-base_help.2.4b3baJixaJixOc\&p=cas) console
CertificateId.description_zh: 域名绑定的SSL证书ID。请在数字证书管理服务 (https://yundunnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.2020520163.console-base_help.2.4b3baJixaJixOc&p=cas)完成上传或购买证书后获取证书ID

CertificateName.description_en: The name of the SSL certificate

CertificateStartDate.description_en: The issuance date of the certificate

CertificateStatus.description_en: The status of the domain name

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the domain name was created

Type.description_en: The type of the domain name

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the domain name was last updated

Message.description_en: The message returned for the request
